# Welcome to Aether.nvim!

Aether.nvim is built for developers who want a customizable, productive, and comfortable coding environment with Neovim.

### Built for the community

This project is intended to be useful to the developer community. Explore the configuration, adapt it to your workflow, and help improve it.

### Privacy matters

Aether.nvim is designed to provide a local development environment. Review its configuration and dependencies so you understand what runs on your system. Plugins and external tools may have their own behavior and privacy policies.

### Download responsibly

Please obtain Aether.nvim and its dependencies from their official or otherwise trusted sources. Be cautious of unofficial packages, modified releases, and unknown scripts that could contain malicious code.

### License agreement

By installing or using Aether.nvim, you agree to comply with the applicable project license and the licenses of its dependencies. Review the license terms before using, modifying, or redistributing the project.

**Thank you for being part of the community. Happy coding!**

— The Aether.nvim Project
